questions.explanation: Third-person singular subject requires the 's' form of the verb.

questions.question_text: What is the noun form of the verb 'decide'?
questions.explanation: Decision is the standard noun form of decide.

questions.question_text: Identify the part of speech of the word 'quickly' in the sentence: 'He ran quickly to the park.'
questions.explanation: Quickly modifies the verb 'ran', making it an adverb.

questions.explanation: Abundant means existing in large quantities, similar to plentiful.

options: Each of the boys are happy.
Each of the boys is happy.
Each of the boys have been happy.
questions.explanation: Subject 'each' is singular, so it requires the singular verb 'is'.

questions.question_text: Which word best completes the phrase: 'The research was _____ based on factual evidence.'
